steps.title: Identify Server Response Format Discrepancies
steps.description: Analyze the exception where local server plain-text responses (e.g. 'Hello!') cause JSON parsing failures within the OpenAI choices structure extractor.

steps.title: Implement Adaptive Response Parsing
steps.description: Enhance handleOpenAiApiResponse to gracefully catch parse errors, falling back to treating the raw payload as a standard text message instead of failing with JSONException.

steps.title: Enhance Custom Schema Parser Fallback
steps.description: Add nested try-catch blocks to separate internal state-extraction JSON schema parsing from the conversational response text extractor.

steps.title: Verify State & Metadata Consistency
steps.description: Ensure that even if the AI responds in plain-text conversational format, the current tracked appointment indicators and SQLite database state are preserved.

steps.title: Optimize Network Thread Response Handlers
steps.description: Update UI status indicator and connection thread state feedback loops to handle fallback scenarios gracefully and avoid thread hangs.

steps.title: Building Hospital AI Booker
steps.description: Compile debug build with the revised robust API parsing strategy to confirm complete stability with local servers.
